#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text: Subject: Drawing, Speech Competitions and “Meri Seva, Mera Sankalp” – Student Reel Making Competition under “Sewa Sankalp Abhiyan” from 17.09.2026 to 17.10.2026 in Government Schools of NCT of Delhi.

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text: The Directorate of Education, Government of NCT of Delhi, is pleased to announce the organisation of various student-centric activities under “Sewa Sankalp Abhiyan”, with the objective of providing students an opportunity to express their ideas, creativity and aspirations relating to public service, development, nation-building and the vision of “Viksit Bharat @2047”. The Abhiyan seeks to highlight the journey of public service over the past 25 years and create awareness among students regarding various welfare and development initiatives.

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: Accordingly, all Heads of Government Schools of NCT of Delhi are directed to ensure active participation of students in the following competitions:

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: 1. “25 Crore Children’s Dreams of India” – Drawing & Speech Competition

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text:
- 25 years of public service and major welfare/development initiatives.
- Vision of a Developed India – Viksit Bharat @2047.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text: 2. Theme for “Meri Seva, Mera Sankalp” – Student Reel Making Competition

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text: Students may create short reels/videos highlighting the following themes:

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text:
- Seva Mera Yogdan – My Contribution to Society.
- Acts of kindness, compassion and community service.
- Youth participation in nation-building.
- Public service and its impact on people’s lives.
- Jan Bhagidari – People’s Participation in Nation Building.
- Cleanliness, environmental protection and civic responsibility.
- Helping the elderly, persons in need and vulnerable sections of society.
- Respect for public property and national symbols.
- Innovative ideas for social good.
- Viksit Bharat @2047 – My Vision, My Contribution.
- Inspiring stories of individuals/communities contributing to society.
